description: This file defines reusable UI card components using React functional components with forwardRef, including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A generic container component for card layout, applying styles and forwarding ref.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: Component for the header section of a card, with flex layout and spacing.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: Component for the title section of a card, styled for emphasis.

methods.name: CardDescription
methods.description: Component for descriptive text within a card, styled as muted text.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: Component for the main content area of a card.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: Component for the footer section of a card, typically for actions or additional info.
